texts.02a428bc3a06: Background 400 have been recruited after a new diagnosis of heart failure is made and followed up for six months.  The study will assess reasons for death or admission to hospital and the psychological impact of  condition on patients.  Aim 1. To describe the mortality and hospitalisation rate in the early period after diagnosis of heart failure in a UK population.2. to describe the mode of death(ie whether patient die suddenly or from progressive intractable heart failure, etc)  in the early period after diagnosis of heart failure in a UK population.3. To describe the psychological impact of a on diagnosis of heart failure and how perceptions change over the short term.
